tours.title: Tashkent tours to Amirsoy and Chimgan
tours.lead: Two excursions, both driven by us: a full day around Tashkent and a full day in the mountains of the Tashkent region. Both leave at 9:00 in the morning and are back at your door at 19:00 the same evening, in one Kia Sportage 2024 with the same driver from start to finish.
tours.section-title: Tours to Amirsoy and the Chimgan mountains
tours.section-lead: Did you know that the Tashkent region has the Western Tian Shan mountains? They are very beautiful, and there is a cable car that climbs to 2,290 metres above sea level and the Charvak reservoir. We locals love these places. Do not forget to visit these attractions — as the apartment owner, I will do my best to share this information with you as soon as possible.
tours.program-note: I will also walk the route with you and advise you where it is worth going inside.

hero.photo: Amirsoy gondola cabins crossing the Western Tian Shan ridges in late afternoon light.

practical.title: Practical notes before you book
practical.lead: Both excursions run on the same shape of day and in the same car, so the only real decisions left to you are the date and which of the two you want first. The mountains around Tashkent change completely between seasons, and the difference between a good day and a cold one is usually a jacket and a start time. The route around the city works in any weather. Here is everything we tell guests before they choose.
practical.season-caption: Best seasons for the two excursions from Tashkent

city.note: Mosques, museums and bazaars work in any weather; spring and autumn are the most comfortable on foot

mountains.note: Snow and working lifts December to March, alpine meadows from May, swimming at Charvak June to September

schedule.pickup: 9:00 — the driver is at your apartment or hotel, no meeting point to find
schedule.city: The Tashkent route works from the old town through the museums and the squares to Magic City
schedule.mountains: The mountain route climbs through Gazalkent into the Bostanlyk valleys, about ninety minutes out
schedule.lunch: Lunch is built into both days — Besh Qozon in the city, the Fayz cafe in the mountains
schedule.guide: Your driver walks the sites with you and advises where a ticket is worth buying
schedule.return: 19:00 — back at the door you were collected from, the same evening
schedule.limit: Up to 10 hours in total; a later finish is possible if you agree it the day before

drive.gazalkent: Gazalkent, the last town before the climb — about 50 minutes

bring.layers: Layers rather than one thick coat — the mountains run ten degrees colder than the city
bring.shoes: Shoes with grip for anything above the cable car stations
bring.sun: Sunglasses and sunscreen, the altitude is deceptive even in winter
bring.cash: Some cash in som for museum tickets, mountain cafes and lifts
bring.water: A water bottle, refilled before you leave the apartment
bring.documents: A passport or ID, which some museums and mountain resorts still ask to see

practical.car-lead: Both excursions are driven in our own Kia Sportage 2024, a business-class compact SUV, by a driver with 22 years behind the wheel. It is the right car for this particular road: high enough for the mountain sections above Gazalkent, small enough to park at a crowded viewpoint, and comfortable enough that ninety minutes each way does not feel like the price of the day.

car.seats: Four passenger seats, so a family or two couples travel together in one car
car.climate: Air conditioning through the summer and a warm cabin on winter mornings
car.boot: Boot space for daypacks, ski gear or airport luggage on the way through
car.driver: The same driver all day, in Russian, Uzbek or English

practical.pickup-title: Pickup and where we collect you
practical.pickup: Every day trip begins wherever you are sleeping. If you are staying in one of our apartments in Tashkent city center the driver comes to the courtyard at the agreed time, and if you are in a hotel anywhere else in the city we collect you from the lobby at no extra cost. Guests arriving on an early flight often go straight from the airport into a mountain day with their luggage in the boot, which we are happy to arrange as part of the transfer.

tashkent-city.title: Tour around Tashkent
tashkent-city.summary: A full day through the Tashkent people actually come here for: the old town around Khast-Imam, the domes of Chorsu bazaar, the palace of a Romanov grand duke, pilaf straight out of the kazan at Besh Qozon, and the museums, squares and mosaic metro stations of the modern centre. We collect you at 9:00, drive between every stop so nothing is a walk in the heat, and have you back at your door by 19:00 the same evening. Ten stops, one car, no group to keep up with.

tashkent-mountains.title: Tour to the mountains of the Tashkent region
tashkent-mountains.summary: The mountain day locals take at the weekend. Ninety minutes out of the city the road climbs through Gazalkent into the Bostanlyk valleys and the whole Western Tian Shan opens up: the Amirsoy resort and its gondola, the ridges under Greater Chimgan, the turquoise Charvak reservoir and the glazed cabins of the Chinorkent cable car. Lunch is at the Fayz cafe in the mountains. We collect you at 9:00 and have you back at your door by 19:00, with as long as you want at every stop.
